moodys.citation_text: Moody's 2023 action: 'Upgrades Indiana University Health's Rating to Aa2 [from Aa3]; Outlook Stable' — implies pre-action rating was Aa3 with positive outlook (consistent with Fitch positive outlook concurrent with this period).

fitch.citation_text: Fitch May 2023: 'affirmed its AA rating on IU Health bonds while revising the system's outlook from positive to stable' — pre-action outlook was Positive.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Upgraded from Aa3 to Aa2; outlook stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Strong demand and cost control measures expected to drive steady margin improvement; very good liquidity.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: 'Moody's upgraded the rating to Aa2 from Aa3 on Indianapolis-based Indiana University Health, affecting $1 billion in debt.'

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed AA; outlook revised to Stable from Positive
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Competition in market area; significant challenges from high labor costs and capital expenditure plans (consolidation of two downtown Indianapolis hospitals).
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch May 31, 2023 affirmed AA, revised outlook to Stable from Positive.

moodys.citation_text: Aa2/Stable in effect from 2023 upgrade onward.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's upgraded IU Health one notch from Aa3 to Aa2 in 2023 — the dominant action. Fitch revised outlook from Positive to Stable but did not change the AA rating. Net: UPGRADE.
